sentences.text: This mater is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Mr. Mathew, learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that pursuant to order dated 23rd June,
2025 passed in W.P.(C) No.2362 of 2025, the Petitioner has already made an application under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettle -ment, 2013 (for brevity, 'the Act') before the Collector, Angul.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettle -ment, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: But unfortunately, the Petitioner could not mention about the rehabilitation and resettlement benefit in the said application.
3. Mr. Mishra, learned ASC, on the other hand, submits that the copy of the petition under Section 64 of the Act stated to have been filed by the Petitioner is not available in the case record.
No such averment is also made in the writ petition.
4. Mr. Mathew, learned counsel for the Petitioner, therefore, prays for an adjournment to take instruction in that regard and file Signed by: SASANKA SEKHAR SATAPATHY
